subject: Urban Planning
title: School Funding and Zoning
description: A short lesson to help you apply School Funding and Zoning.

hook.text: American schools are funded by property taxes. Expensive neighborhoods get great schools. Poor ones get underfunded ones.

buildup.text: Zoning controls property values. By limiting density, suburbs inflate home prices and capture more school funding.

discovery.text: The feedback loop: good schools raise prices, higher prices fund better schools, better schools raise prices further.

twist.text: Families buy homes specifically for school districts. Zoning that blocks affordable housing blocks poorer students too.

climax.text: Some states redistribute property tax for schools equally. Others let wealthy districts keep every dollar locally.

punchline.text: Where you live decides your education. Zoning decides where you can afford to live.

quiz.question: How does zoning affect school quality in the US?
options: Zoning determines which schools teach which subjects
Restrictive zoning inflates property values, concentrating school funding in wealthy areas
Schools in commercially zoned areas receive extra business tax revenue
